identityReference.description: Approved Watcher skin identity sheet: original anime heroine in a violet short kimono-robe, white blindfold with a gold closed-eye sigil, magenta ribbons, gold-tipped staff (generated, not committed)

poster.description: Monogatari series second-season key art: extreme low camera angle, cloudless cobalt sky, white geometric masts, stacked diagonal figures (copyrighted, not committed)

closeup.description: Monogatari series close-up frame: huge flat eyes with crisp highlights, shard-like flat hair, fine linework, painted sea and cloud backdrop (copyrighted, not committed)

classroom.description: Monogatari series group frame: hard diagonal shadow cuts, cracked grey wall with one hot flat colour panel, geometric clutter, long limbs (copyrighted, not committed)

cards.scene: A wide high swing of her staff knocks three enemy silhouettes over like bowling pins in a row, seen from a low angle with a cloudless sky and white geometry.
She steps through a fold in the world: the frame is split by a hard diagonal where the two halves show mirrored views of the same room, her palm raised toward her golden-lit double.
She kneels calmly before an empty wooden bowl with her hands in her lap, a pale green light rising around her, emblem composition with calm margins.
She shapes flat glowing geometric blocks floating around her with one open palm, calm face tilted, symmetric emblem composition with cloudless sky.
She presses one finger to a pressure point on an enemy silhouette's shoulder while small flat glowing dots mark points along its body outline, classroom-style shadow cut.
She waves one lazy palm and a wave of rippling pale violet rings rolls across the frame, long sleeve fluttering in flat shapes, enemy silhouettes sagging at the edges.

A high spinning wheel kick seen side-on from waist height: one long leg sweeping a big flat circle across the frame with a flat gold impact burst at its end, her blindfold ribbons trailing, cloudless sky.
A single clean staff strike: the gold leaf-shaped staff head slams forward toward the camera in a low angle, she leans into it with ribbons trailing, cloudless sky.
She holds her staff horizontally across her body with both hands while a flat gold ring of light stands behind it like a halo shield, head tilted, hard shadow cut.
She thrusts one open palm forward and a ring of flat gold-orange flame spikes erupts outward from it, her jaw set under the blindfold, ribbons whipping upward, low angle.
She stands serene with the staff upright in one hand and her other palm open, a flat slate-blue circle behind her, deadpan calm, symmetrical.
She sweeps her staff low and a ring of gold light flashes outward across the ground to the horizon, enemy silhouettes at the edge of the ring, low camera.
She exhales while her body turns transparent, only a thin outline left with loose leaves blowing through her, calm tilted head, emblem composition.
A bare-handed palm strike thrust straight at the camera with a flat gold circular impact burst around it, her blindfold and ribbons behind.
High angle: she cups both hands as small gold and violet orbs gather into her palms from the air, ribbon pooling at her feet.
She raises one flat palm to the camera in a stop gesture and a pale wall of light stands in front of it, enemy silhouette halted at the edge, low angle.
Emblem composition: a small flat flame flickers above her clenched fist as her sleeve lifts, violet dusk behind, calm margins.
She stands barefoot on a perfectly still water surface with rings rippling from her feet, staff resting on her shoulder, cloudless sky above.
She chants with her hands pressed together while a ring of small gold swords hovers around her like a halo, symmetric emblem composition.
She stands with hands clasped inside a floating fortress of flat translucent geometric panels, a calm serene face, symmetric emblem composition.
She charges forward with fists clenched, a flat gold flame silhouette trailing behind her and wind-stripes, low camera, magenta ribbons streaming.
She floats cross-legged above a flat lotus shape with a ring of gold light behind her, small gold dots drifting upward, emblem composition.
Emblem composition: her gold closed-eye sigil glows on the blindfold while three small translucent windows floating around her head show glimpses of the future, tilted head.
She slams the staff butt into the ground and a ring of violet energy shakes the enemy silhouettes at its edge, clenched jaw under the blindfold, low angle.
She sits in meditation with her hands on her knees, a flat slate-blue circle behind her, ribbons pooling, still and symmetrical.
She slashes the air with the staff tip, opening a thin glowing violet slit in space from which a small golden blade falls, high angle, classroom-style shadow cut.
She snaps her long magenta sash across the frame like a whip, the sash a bold curved line with a flat spark at its tip, low camera.
She ends her stance with one long decisive horizontal sweep of the staff, a bright gold line cutting across the whole frame behind her.
She points one finger forward at an enemy silhouette while a ring and a single beam of gold light fall from above onto it, symmetric, stern tilted head.
She raises the staff and five golden thunder spears rain down from a dark storm sky onto enemy silhouettes, wrath stance, low angle, no red.
She draws a looping glowing line in the air with one finger, forming abstract shapes (no letters) that float around her, a small amused tilt of the head.
She strikes one dramatic finishing pose with the staff pointed to the sky and one hand on her hip, low camera, a spotlight panel behind her.
A large translucent spirit guardian with wide arms wraps around her like a shield of ghostly gold, she stands calmly in front of it, symmetrical.

She stands upright with both bare feet planted in a wide stance, her whole body and both legs clearly visible, and pivots at the waist while sweeping the staff held in both hands in a flat spiral to block; flat spiral lines mark the turn and her ribbons spin around her, slightly high three-quarter camera angle, calm deadpan face.
She slams the staff down and the ground cracks into big flat shards flying up, low camera, hard diagonal shadow cuts.
She kneels and cups her hands as a flat glowing star rises from them into the cloudless sky, ribbon drifting, calm tilted head.
Emblem composition: she floats serenely haloed in a symmetric flat golden aura with wide wings of light, staff held vertical, calm margins.
She spreads her hands as her gold eye sigil glows and a vast eye of light opens behind her, a constellation of tiny cards around, symmetric.
She vaults over a white wall with the staff as a pole, a long arc across the cloudless sky, low camera, long limbs.
She holds a stern flat palm to the camera, a flat gold burst on the palm, enemy silhouette flinching beyond it, low angle.
She stomps the ground with shockwave rings spreading, sleeves and ribbons flared in wrath, flat gold-orange panel behind her, low camera.
She dances in a turn with the staff and her magenta ribbon tracing a figure-eight pattern in the air, elegant long limbs.
She bows forward with clasped hands beneath a dark violet sun, ominous and quiet, hard shadow cut, tilted head.
She fires a beam of pure gold light from her open palm straight at the camera, the beam a bold flat shape, ribbons blown back.
Emblem composition: she kneels in prayer inside a pool of golden light with a flat radiant sun behind her.
She kneels with her forehead lowered over folded hands, a shaft of gold light falling on her, ribbon pooling.
She holds the staff upright with a wreath of flat gold flames spinning around its head, her face calm, symmetric.
Emblem composition: a golden sword forms in the air in front of her, blade in profile, she regards it with her head tilted, calm margins.
A great shaft of gold light falls from above onto her while tiny winged figures of light circle in the air, a mechanical gold ring above, symmetric.
She mimics the stance of a different ghostly fighter silhouette behind her, performing its kick, two overlaid poses, flat violet and gold.
Emblem composition: stacked rings of gold light descend like a countdown above her head as she stands under them with her hands joined, calm margins.
She lunges upward thrusting the staff at the sky and a beam opens a hole in the clouds, extreme low camera angle.
Emblem composition: she reads a floating scroll of abstract diagrams (no letters) by the glow of her gold eye sigil, a stack of books beside her.
She plants the staff upright like a pillar and a flat temple platform forms around it, symmetric emblem composition.
She sits cross-legged with a small gold orb floating above her open palm, calm, a flat cloudless sky behind.
She braces against a strong wind with the staff planted and sleeves flapping in flat shapes, steady, low camera.
She smashes a golden hourglass with the staff and streams of gold sand burst outward, high angle, classroom-style shadow cut.
She spins the staff in a big windmill circle overhead and brings it down, flat circular motion lines, low camera.
She raises her arms and gold rings of sound grow larger and larger around her in a flat expanding series, wrath-tilted head.
Five rapid palm strikes shown as overlapping afterimage hands fanning across the frame, one clear fist in front.
Her wide sleeves fly out like blades slashing two bright gold arcs across the frame, low camera, cloudless sky.
She shields herself behind the staff and one wide sleeve, a curved barrier arc of pale light in front, steady stance.
She bows low with both hands on the floor and the ribbon pooling around her, a small gold orb floating over her head.
She holds her hands together in prayer, gold light glowing between her palms, head tilted down, serene.
Huge close-up of her blindfold with the gold closed-eye sigil glowing, a small pointed chin below, a calm flat panel behind.
She slices through one long gold thread of fate with the staff tip, flat star sparks, thread curling away in bold curves, low camera.
She tosses a small die and a coin together into the air with a small knowing tilt of her head, cloudless sky, flat gold highlights.
She sits unmoving under a cloudless sky with a gentle ripple on the water, staff across her knees, still and symmetrical.
She sits with her head tilted as thoughts drift out of it like leaves of light, flat and quiet, a gold ring behind.
She twists an enemy silhouette's arm into a hold with both hands, non-graphic, flat violet shadow cut, low camera.
She stands unflinching with one palm raised before a huge looming dark silhouette's strike, the staff planted, calm and symmetric.
